opportunities.title: ArcX Climate Change Resilience - Formation of a Network of Regional Centres of Excellence on Climate Change Resilience in Sub-Saharan Africa (Call 2026_ArcX_G261)
opportunities.funder: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), on behalf of the European Union (DG INTPA, NDICI-Global Europe), with EC JRC
opportunities.program: EU Africa Regional Centres of Excellence (ArcX) Programme - Climate Change Resilience component (Global Gateway)
opportunities.deadline_text: The deadline for the ArcX Programme Call for Proposals 09 December2026, at 14:00 CET (last date for clarification requests 25 November 2026)
opportunities.funding_text: A total budget of EUR 1,500,000 is available for this Call with the aim to award six Grants. Tier 1-2: EUR 250,000-350,000; Tier 3: EUR 150,000-200,000; Tier 4: EUR 50,000. Lump sum grant; budget categories incl. personnel costs; 25% flat-rate indirect costs.
opportunities.duration: Start 1 March-1 May 2027, end 31 December 2029 (32-34 months)
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Entities eligible under ECMWF grant rules (ECMWF Member/Cooperating States) and under Art. 28 NDICI: international organisations and legal entities established in EU, EEA, IPA III, non-G20 ODA-recipient countries, etc. Coordinator must be the prospective Regional Centre of Excellence on Climate Change Resilience (RCoE-C2R) with a formal mandate from governments of at least 2 African countries and/or an intergovernmental organisation.
opportunities.eligible_countries: Place of performance: Sub-Saharan Africa. Participants per Schedule 1 (EU/EEA/ECMWF states, non-G20 developing countries; OECD states only when implemented exclusively in LDC/HIPC; international organisations).
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: International organisations are explicitly eligible as participants (Schedule 1 B), so the Alliance (Bioversity International, Italy = EU Member State; Nairobi office) could join a multi-beneficiary grant as a Beneficiary (with budget) or Associated Partner (no budget). The Alliance cannot realistically be Coordinator, because the Coordinator must be the prospective RCoE-C2R with a formal regional mandate recognised by at least 2 African governments or an IGO (e.g., ICPAC, AGRHYMET, SADC CSC). Best route: co-beneficiary with a regional climate centre, bringing agricultural climate-services, EO/AI and crop-impact expertise.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Coordinator = prospective RCoE-C2R; 'formal mandate' = authorisation/designation/endorsement by governmental authorities of at least two African countries or territories and/or by one or more intergovernmental organisations, evidenced by official documentation; WMO/AUC recognition an asset. Formal commitment to host the RCoE-C2R function required.
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Project must be carried out in Sub-Saharan Africa (Eastern, Western, Central, Southern Africa, Indian Ocean Islands, or SSA-wide).
opportunities.consortium_details: Mono-beneficiary or multi-beneficiary grants allowed; Associated Partners (unfunded) and Subcontractors (max 20% of costs) permitted. Consortium agreement may be required at grant preparation.
opportunities.cofunding_details: Lump-sum grant covering expected eligible direct and indirect costs; no co-financing requirement found in the Call text read.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Operating the RCoE-C2R and network-of-networks; stakeholder needs assessment for climate services, EO products, AI/ML applications and Copernicus/DestinE data; priority sectors incl. agriculture, water, health, energy; making data AI-ready, data rescue, Forecast-in-a-Box pilots, Code for Earth / AI Weather Quest activities, training, science-policy engagement.
opportunities.required_documents: Online questionnaire on ProContract portal; Application Form incl. Annex I Technical Description (max 25 pages, English, with Appendix 1 operational capacity and Appendix 2 tier checklist), Annex II Estimated Budget per beneficiary and work package, supporting documents incl. formal mandate evidence and commitment to host RCoE-C2R.
opportunities.application_procedure: Coordinator registers interest on ECMWF submission portal (ProContract / Due North, https://procurement.ecmwf.int) to access the Call package, then submits electronically before 9 Dec 2026 14:00 CET. Only the coordinating organisation should register.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: AI-enabled climate services, EO/Copernicus data use and agriculture-sector climate information are central; strong match to EO/AI/climate-data profile, though the grant mainly funds centre operations and networking rather than research.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: EU Global Gateway flagship with ECMWF/JRC/WMO/AUC; CIFOR-ICRAF already coordinates the ArcX Biodiversity component; positions the Alliance in Africa's regional climate-services architecture (links to AICCRA legacy).
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Alliance has climate-services and EO/crop-modelling capacity in Africa, but success depends on a mandated regional centre leading; short timeline (5 weeks).
opportunities.recommendation: Pursue as co-beneficiary: contact a mandated regional climate centre (e.g., ICPAC for Eastern Africa, AGRHYMET for West Africa, SADC Climate Services Centre) this week and offer an agriculture/EO-AI work package. Small budgets per grant, but multi-year (to end-2029) and opens follow-on ArcX grants.
opportunities.potential_partners: ICPAC (IGAD), AGRHYMET/CILSS, SADC Climate Services Centre, ACMAD, RCMRD, national meteorological services; CIFOR-ICRAF (ArcX Biodiversity coordinator); AICCRA partners.
opportunities.next_action: By 15 Nov 2026: identify a mandated RCoE-C2R candidate (ICPAC is the natural fit for the Nairobi office), agree role as Beneficiary and budget share; submit clarification questions before 25 Nov 2026.

opportunities.title: Minciencias Convocatoria 54 - Convocatoria especial para la financiación de proyectos para el fortalecimiento de las capacidades científico-tecnológicas (SGR CTeI, bienio 2025-2026)
opportunities.funder: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación de Colombia (Minciencias) - Sistema General de Regalías (SGR), Asignación para la CTeI
opportunities.program: SGR Asignación CTeI - convocatoria especial regional (bienio 2025-2026)
opportunities.funding_text: COP $927.591.817.322 total, distributed equally among the six SGR regions (COP $154.598.636.220 per region); 'El valor máximo por proyecto con cargo al SGR es de ... ($17.177.626.246)'; approx. 54 projects.
opportunities.duration: Hasta cuarenta y ocho (48) meses, incluidos el alistamiento y el cierre
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Alliances of at least four distinct national legal entities (by NIT): an IES (Ley 30/1992), another SNCTI entity (IES or Minciencias-recognised actor), a territorial entity of the region, and a user/adopter (producer org, company, civil society, ethnic organisation, etc.). Proponent must hold Minciencias SNCTI-actor recognition or meet CTeI track-record criteria (Decreto 1821/2020 art. 1.2.3.2.2).
opportunities.eligible_countries: Colombia (project executed in at least 2 departments of the same SGR region)
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: International entities may join as allies through a 'Carta de intención de participación' (no NIT, do not sign the aval letter, not part of governance model) and must quantify an in-kind or cash contribution in COP; an international ally with quantified contribution earns +1 evaluation point. This route does not appear to give the international ally SGR funds. Whether CIAT (HQ in Palmira/Cali with Colombian registration) could participate as a national alliance member/proponent with NIT and SNCTI recognition was not verified.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Proponent: SNCTI actor with current Minciencias recognition at closing date, or entity with CTeI activities meeting suitability/track-record criteria; an alliance member must have a research group category A1/A/B/C; at least 2 additional CTeI projects in last 10 years.
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Projects executed in at least two departments of the same SGR region (Caribe, Pacífico, Centro Sur-Amazonía, Llanos, Centro Oriente, Eje Cafetero-Antioquia).
opportunities.consortium_details: Minimum 4 national legal entities (IES + SNCTI entity + territorial entity + user/adopter); international allies optional via letter of intent.
opportunities.cofunding_details: Cada integrante de la alianza deberá aportar una contrapartida en efectivo o en especie, cuantificada en términos monetarios, independientemente del rol que desempeñe.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Experimental/theoretical R&D, proofs of concept, equipment, platforms/software/ICT infrastructure, specialised R&D training, social appropriation, hiring of human talent (young researchers, master's students, postdocs 24-36 months), national/international mobility, IP management, project administration. Thematic lines incl. Line 2 'sistemas agroalimentarios inteligentes y regenerativos', Line 9 'agua, clima, riesgos y sostenibilidad territorial', Line 5 'territorios inteligentes: IA, conectividad, datos'.
opportunities.required_documents: Anexo 1 carta unificada de aval/compromiso/gobernanza; Anexo 2 documento técnico; Anexo 3 presupuesto; Anexo 5 proyectos CTeI; Anexo 12 vinculación de talento humano; letters of intent for international entities (Spanish or English); SIGP registration.
opportunities.application_procedure: Submit through Minciencias SIGP platform before 13 Nov 2026 16:00; preliminary results 3 Dec 2026, final 10 Dec 2026; eligible projects enter bank for SGR approval.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Agrifood systems, water/climate risk and AI/data lines directly accommodate digital agriculture, crop modelling, EO-based climate risk work.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Large SGR resources in CIAT's host country; 4-year projects; strengthens partnerships with Colombian universities, governorships and producer organisations.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Technically deliverable, but very short window (11 days) and requires an already-formed national alliance; Alliance funding route uncertain.
opportunities.recommendation: Only realistic as international ally (letter of intent + in-kind contribution) in a Colombian university-led alliance already preparing a proposal, or as national member if CIAT's NIT/SNCTI status allows. Worth quick outreach to university partners for Pacífico-region agrifood/climate projects.
opportunities.potential_partners: Universidad Nacional de Colombia (Palmira), Universidad del Valle, Universidad del Cauca, AGROSAVIA, Gobernación del Valle/Cauca, producer associations (FEDEARROZ, Cenicaña).
opportunities.next_action: Within days: confirm with Alliance legal/partnerships whether CIAT can participate as a national entity (NIT, SNCTI recognition); otherwise offer letters of intent with quantified in-kind contribution to partner alliances before 13 Nov 2026.

evidence.eligibility_quote: Las entidades internacionales podrán participar como aliadas mediante la «Carta de intención de participación en el proyecto» (numeral 11.11). No requieren NIT ni suscriben la carta de aval

evidence.staff_costs_quote: Vinculación de talento humano, incluidos jóvenes investigadores e innovadores, estudiantes de maestría y doctores en estancia posdoctoral.

opportunities.title: Minciencias Convocatoria 55 - Convocatoria especial para la financiación de macroproyectos nacionales para el fortalecimiento de las capacidades científico-tecnológicas del país (SGR CTeI)
opportunities.funder: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación de Colombia (Minciencias) - Sistema General de Regalías (SGR)
opportunities.program: SGR Asignación CTeI - macroproyectos nacionales multirregionales (bienio 2025-2026)
opportunities.funding_text: Indicative COP $500.000.000.000 from SGR CTeI 2025-2026 to fund ten (10) macroprojects; up to COP $50.000.000.000 per macroproject from the SGR.
opportunities.duration: 36 to 48 months (TdR: execution period must be within 'treinta y seis (36) a cuarenta y ocho (48) meses')
opportunities.eligible_applicants: Alliances of at least three distinct Colombian legal entities (proponent + at least 2 members); proponent must be a Minciencias-recognised SNCTI actor or have CTeI track record; at least one member must be a territorial entity, company, or social/ethnic-territorial organisation.
opportunities.eligible_countries: Colombia (direct intervention in at least 2 SGR regions)
opportunities.cgiar_eligibility_notes: TdR 10.11: international entities may form part of the project via a free-format letter of intent signed by the institute/centre director, specifying a cash or in-kind contribution in COP; not part of the governance model. Same caveat as Conv. 54: international allies appear unfunded; CIAT national-entity status unverified.
opportunities.lead_applicant_requirements: Proponent with current Minciencias SNCTI recognition or verified CTeI activities and track record per TdR.
opportunities.geographic_restrictions: Must intervene directly in at least two SGR regions, at least one department in each.
opportunities.consortium_details: Minimum 3 national legal entities; lines: (1) shared S&T capacities and services, (2) multiregional development/validation of CTeI solutions, (3) multiregional demonstration/transfer/adoption (solutions must already show verifiable validation).
opportunities.cofunding_details: Not confirmed from the TdR excerpts read; check Anexo 3 Presupuesto.
opportunities.eligible_activities: Multiregional CTeI macroprojects addressing territorial demands (Anexo 4); shared scientific-technological services; validation and adoption of CTeI solutions; human-talent formation.
opportunities.required_documents: TdR annexes incl. Anexo 3 Presupuesto, Anexo 4 Demandas territoriales, Anexo 12 Requisitos; letters of intent for international entities; SIGP submission.
opportunities.application_procedure: Submission via SIGP before 13 Nov 2026 16:00; preliminary results 3 Dec 2026; final 10 Dec 2026.
opportunities.scientific_alignment_rationale: Thematic scope set by territorial demands (Anexo 4, not reviewed); a multiregional agro-climatic services / digital agriculture platform could fit lines 1-3.
opportunities.strategic_relevance_rationale: Very large multi-year national projects in Colombia; a shared agro-climatic data/AI service platform would be high-visibility for the Alliance.
opportunities.technical_feasibility_rationale: Only 10 macroprojects nationally; requires mature, already-validated solutions and a strong national alliance within 11 days.
opportunities.recommendation: Low probability unless a national alliance is already preparing a climate/agri macroproject; offer letter of intent as international ally where relevant.
opportunities.potential_partners: Universidad Nacional de Colombia, AGROSAVIA, IDEAM, universities in Pacífico and Caribe regions, departmental governments.
opportunities.next_action: Check Anexo 4 territorial demands for agri-climate topics; contact Colombian university partners to ask if any macroproject consortium needs an international ally before 13 Nov 2026.

evidence.eligibility_quote: Para el caso de las entidades internacionales que formen parte del proyecto, se deberá anexar carta de intención de participación en el proyecto (formato libre)
evidence.staff_costs_quote: Not specified for international allies; TdR section '9. Orientaciones para la vinculación de talento humano' covers project human-talent hiring by the executing entity.
